description: Defines the ExpiringTimerBuilder class which constructs timers with expiration handling, including scheduling expiration and cancellation logic.

classes.name: ExpiringTimerBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating timers with expiration logic, supporting tags, expiration handling, and maximum duration configuration.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer, overriding existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer, overriding existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: expirationHandling
methods.description: Sets custom handling logic to execute when the timer expires.

methods.name: maximumDuration
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration the timer should run before expiring.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and starts the timer, scheduling expiration handling based on maximum duration.

methods.name: cancelScheduledExpirationFuture
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled expiration task if the timer is stopped before timeout.

methods.name: defaultExpirationHandling
methods.description: Default logic executed upon timer expiration, optionally invoking custom expiration handling.
